finding: No view says what happens after premerge-check refuses a story merge. PremergeStoryCheck ends with exit 1, the Ledger Entry Lifecycle has no transition for a refused merge-story, and the entry stays dispatched. The implementation agent's next step is unnamed: rerun the gate-check step and mark-failed for a failing gate, spawn a developer agent for an open finding, or stop for the User on a scope failure. RunByHand step 10 also shows the output of premerge-check before the go without naming the call, such as merge-story --dry-run. Add the path after a refusal to 6.23 or 6.24 and name the dry run in RunByHand. Owner: architecture-agent.
why_this_severity: The existing edges cover a gate failure once the implementation agent reruns the gate-check step, so an implementer can act (no to fails_purpose); the author of the implementation agent definition must still work out each refusal case alone (raises_cost).
